title: Protocol semver guards, build control logs, block dump, time-align seal

context.goal: Добавить управляемые механизмы диагностики и совместимости: контроль сборки в логах, semver-guard для пиров, debug-dump блоков и time-align запечатывания.
context.motivation: Снизить риск silent-divergence и ускорить root-cause при рассинхроне same-shard узлов.

delegations.prompt_summary: Design/debug gate: mapped existing code locations for build-control logs, peer protocol versioning, divergence block dumps, seal time controls, and same-validator-key divergence risk; no product Rust edits.

repro.command: No repro run requested; design gate used CQDS-first code mapping and static review.

notes: CQDS-first followed: colloquium-cqds-mcp skill read, cq_help called before cq_files_ctl, project_id=5 used for code mapping.
Recommendation: split into Slice A (build log + protocol semver + workflow discipline) and Slice B (debug block dump + divergence controls + time-align seal).
Risk assessment: time-align can reduce boundary drift only; deterministic seal time remains the only MVP hash-parity mechanism.

delegations.prompt_summary: Slice 1 implementation: startup build-control log marker, protocol semver guard in handshake path, semver bump discipline update in coding/review prompts, and targeted tests.
notes: Semver rule applied: major mismatch rejects with explicit reason; minor/patch mismatch allowed with warn log.
Build control startup marker logs binary path + binary mtime (UTC unix ms marker) + lightweight build marker.
Task keeps Slice 2 open (debug dump/time-align controls not included in this coding leg).

delegations.prompt_summary: Slice 1 validation: semver handshake reject/warn-only, build-control log fields, targeted pwmd tests + cargo check.
notes: Targeted cargo test filters: handshake compat + incoming_hello semver + main binary_meta; full incoming_hello module + dial trust test.
Patch fractional mismatch shares minor branch; no dedicated patch-only integration test.
cargo check -p pwmd ok.
Commits validated: 08cc97d, 223057f.

delegations.prompt_summary: Slice 1 final gate: semver rules, build-control logs, reason/metrics, prompt discipline, merge readiness.
notes: Verdict: approve with nits; merge readiness: ready.
Must-fix for slice1 scope: none. Nits: reword commit 08cc97d message; document crate vs PWM_PROTOCOL_VERSION in ops/runbook; optional patch-only test.

delegations.prompt_summary: Slice 2 implementation: persistent-divergence block dump controls, mid-second seal align mode with deterministic precedence, docs/runbook updates, and targeted tests.
notes: Divergence dump trigger is persistent by node: dump activates only when consecutive SyncTipDivergence streak reaches debug_dump_trigger_streak (default 2), with streak reset on clean tip announce.
Dump writes are bounded by debug_dump_cap (default 16) and default path resolves to <data_file_parent>/blocks/b{height}.json with fallback state/blocks.
Mid-second align is opt-in and deterministic seal-time remains authoritative (align is ignored with warning when deterministic mode is enabled).
Validation run: cargo fmt --all; scripts/check_rust_fn_name_segments.py on touched files; targeted dump/align tests; cargo check -p pwmd.

delegations.prompt_summary: Slice 2 validation: divergence dump streak/cap, dump paths b{height}.json, time-align vs deterministic precedence, defaults OFF; targeted pwmd tests + cargo check.
notes: Commits validated: ad0bee1 (coding), e3e0e24 (ticket ledger).
debug_dump::tests (4) + dump_on_div_default_off + handshake lib smoke (16); cargo check -p pwmd ok.
Integration gap: no harness for consecutive SyncTipDivergence streak nor CapReached after max_files.

delegations.prompt_summary: Slice 2 final gate: divergence dump trigger/cap/path, time-align precedence, defaults OFF, merge readiness.
notes: Verdict: approve_with_nits; merge readiness: ready.
Must-fix: none. Naming checker clean on touched pwmd paths; wire unchanged in slice2.
Residual: integration gap on streak/CapReached; theoretical race widening dump cap under parallel peers.

residual_risks: No automated test for consecutive SyncTipDivergence streak before dump nor for CapReached after max_files.
Global dump_count check vs increment is not fully atomic across peers — cap may slightly overshoot under concurrency.
Full-block JSON dumps imply operator disk and confidentiality responsibility when debug dump is enabled.
Log marker uses CARGO_PKG_VERSION; wire hello uses PWM_PROTOCOL_VERSION — operators need a clear distinction unless logs are extended.
No dedicated patch-only handshake test (same code path as minor warn).
Main implementation commit message is placeholder text.

slice_recommendation_detail.slice_a: Build control log + protocol semver guard + coding/review version bump discipline.
slice_recommendation_detail.slice_b: Controlled divergence block dump + persistent divergence trigger + debug-only time-align seal.
